Class StripeService.LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments

public class StripeService.LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments
implements Queueable

Queueable class that links Stripe transactions to their corresponding Payment2__c records by matching PaymentIntentId values. Processes transactions in batches, creates bidirectional relationships between StripeTransaction__c and Payment2__c records, and chains itself for additional batches if needed. Upon completion, automatically enqueues the AssignReferences job.

Methods

public void execute(QueueableContext context)

Executes the queueable job to link Stripe transactions with payments. Fetches a batch of transactions, queries for matching Payment2__c records by PaymentIntentId, establishes bidirectional relationships, and updates both objects. Automatically chains to process remaining batches or enqueues AssignReferences upon completion.

Parameters:
    context – QueueableContext: The context in which the job is executed
